change_summary: Recognize vague attachment-retention work, preserve source files before synthesis, and make direct developer organization missions own bounded Work Model inference without Reply-only bindings.

canonical_skill.note: The internal shared Skill release 1.7.4 adds a natural attachment-bundle trigger and keeps source retention plus Work Model organization distinct from summary creation.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-09.7 remains wire-compatible; the server now gives developer-direct organization missions their own semantic authority instead of requiring Reply-only execution bindings.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.4 while retaining the compatible 2026-09-09.7 collaboration contract.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.23 remains compatible with the unchanged 2026-09-09.7 wire contract; this release does not change CLI bytes.

help_center.note: Existing multilingual MCP Help already covers natural delegation and canonical artifact URLs; no Help bytes change in 1.7.4.

package_setup.note: OAuth endpoints, scopes, installation commands, and session-refresh ownership do not change.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline keeps vague user prompts separate from explicit host attachment context, preserves concrete adapter receipts, and requires source retention plus terminal organization readback before source-to-Work-Model acceptance.

external_marketplaces.note: Anthropic, WorkBuddy, and other account-owned listing or fresh-host acceptance remains pending until external receipts exist.

release_evidence.note: Regression evidence covers canonical artifact identity, real attachment context, source retention, terminal organization receipts, direct-versus-Reply mission authority, no-call controls, semantic review, cross-host reuse, typed Spreadsheet routing, and the provider-live Skill admission countercase.
